Full-time | $65,000 to $85,000 | Remote

Do you like solving accounting puzzles?

Some accountants like maintaining clean books.

You like figuring out why they aren't clean in the first place.

Breakwater Accounting & Advisory is looking for a Cleanup Manager who gets genuine satisfaction from taking messy financials, figuring out what happened, and turning them into books that leadership can actually trust.

You investigate. You trace the money. You ask questions. You test theories. You rebuild accounts. You find the root cause. Then you create a clean, reliable financial picture that the client and our ongoing accounting team can trust.

And then?

You move on to the next puzzle.

This is a role for someone who enjoys variety and problem solving. You'll work on multiple cleanup projects at once, diving into each one, solving the problem, creating a clean handoff, and moving forward.

What You'll Do

Find the mess. Figure out what happened. Fix it. Prove it's right. Move on to the next puzzle.

Investigate and solve

  • Dig into messy financial records to understand what happened and why.
  • Trace transactions to uncover errors, missing information, and broken processes.
  • Develop practical cleanup plans and work through them to completion.
  • Reconstruct financial activity when the existing records don't tell the full story.

Prove the numbers are right

  • Reconcile and substantiate major balance sheet accounts including cash, payroll, loans, revenue, prepaids, accruals, fixed assets, and equity.
  • Create supporting schedules and documentation that show why the numbers are right.
  • Go beyond “it balances” to create financials that are accurate, explainable, and defensible.

Make the books make sense

  • Redesign charts of accounts when they no longer serve the business.
  • Organize financial reporting so business owners can understand what is actually happening.
  • Identify the story behind the numbers and make that story easier to see.

Fix what caused the problem

  • You'll reverse-engineer workflows such as invoicing, payroll, inventory, and expenses to understand where things went wrong.
  • Help create better processes so the same problem doesn't show up again.

We don't believe in cleaning up the same mess twice.

Use your accounting and technology expertise

  • QuickBooks Online is one of your primary tools. You'll troubleshoot complex issues, untangle stubborn balances, and find solutions when the obvious answer isn't working.
  • We're a tech-forward team. We use modern accounting technology and AI to solve problems and improve efficiency. You don't need to be an AI expert. You do need to be curious and willing to try new approaches.

Communicate and collaborate

  • Work directly with clients to ask smart questions, gather missing information, explain complicated accounting issues, and keep projects moving.
  • Collaborate with the Breakwater team, document your work, and create clean handoffs to the ongoing accounting team.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting.
  • 5+ years of high-level accounting, audit, or full-cycle bookkeeping experience.
  • Strong understanding of how balance sheets actually work.
  • Experience with accruals, revenue recognition, depreciation, amortization, and other complex accounting concepts.
  • Prior reviewer, senior accountant, audit, or similar experience.
  • Proven experience cleaning up messy or inaccurate financials.
  • Expert-level QuickBooks Online proficiency.
  • Excellent investigative and problem-solving instincts.
  • Ability to stay focused and see a problem through to completion.
  • Confidence communicating complex financial issues to non-accountants.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects without losing the details.

Experience in an outsourced, multi-client accounting environment is a plus, as is experience with tools such as Xero, Dext, Ramp, BILL, Gusto, ACS/Realm, and advanced Excel.

Why Breakwater?

At Breakwater, you'll work with businesses and nonprofits across a variety of industries, so no two cleanup projects are exactly alike.

You'll join a team that values being proactive, positive, prepared, purposeful, protective, and principled.

You'll also get:

  • $65,000 to $85,000 salary
  • Full-time employment
  • Five weeks of PTO
  • Benefits
  • A collaborative, supportive team
  • Challenging accounting work where you get to solve problems every day

If you read this and thought, “that sounds like fun!” we want to meet you.

Key Responsibilities:

Accounting Management:

- Ensure compliance with accounting principles, standards, and regulations.
- Prepare and review financial statements, reports, and records.
- Conduct regular audits and resolve discrepancies.
- Perform detailed reconciliation checks to ensure accuracy and completeness of financial data.

Migration Projects:

- Plan and execute data migration projects from various accounting software (QuickBooks, Sage, Xero) to Zoho Books.
- Develop customized migration strategies tailored to each client's business operations.
- Ensure zero downtime and seamless business operations during live migration processes.

Project Management:

- Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely completion of migration and accounting projects.
- Monitor project progress and report on key metrics.
- Maintain detailed documentation of migration processes and procedures.

Continuous Improvement:

- Stay updated with the latest developments in Zoho Books and other accounting software.
- Recommend and implement improvements to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of migration projects.
- Contribute to the development of best practices for data migration and client support.

Nice to Have

  • Strong hands-on experience with Zoho Books

  • Experience in SaaS, fin-tech, accounting firm

  • Experience with data migration projects

  • Advanced Excel skills including: Power Query, Power Pivot

  • Experience in building SQL reports

Work Setup

  • Remote (BYOD): Must have a personal laptop/PC and a stable internet connection

  • Working Hours: EST time zone (5 AM – 2 PM EST)

  • Work Environment: High-autonomy, ownership-heavy, and fast-paced


Benefits

Salary Range

Benefits

  • Fully remote work with location flexibility

  • Medical insurance benefits (post-confirmation)

  • 24 days of paid time off (PTO)

  • Opportunity to work with a Canadian employer, compliant with international standards

  • Strong focus on professional growth and continuous learning
